newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LE SAUX RETURNS TO CHELSEA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LE SAUX RETURNS TO CHELSEA.

text.p: Chelsea splashed out a club-record five million pounds ($8 million) on Friday to sign England defender Graeme Le Saux from Blackburn.
The wing-back returns to the London club he left for Rovers in March 1993 for 690,000 pounds ($1.1 million).
Chelsea's managing director Colin Hutchinson admitted: "It's taken us four and a half years and five million pounds to rectify our mistake, but we welcome Graeme back to Stamford Bridge."
The transfer was one of the game's best kept secrets. Negotiations began on Wednesday and the deal was formally completed in the early hours of Friday morning.
Chelsea are rumoured to have beaten off Juventus, Arsenal and Atletico Madrid to sign the 28-year-old on a four-year contract.

Le Saux said the Chelsea he was returning to was very different to the one he left. "I think it shows the way the club has grown that they are prepared to put aside the past. It shows that their priority is football.
"I'm very excited at the opportunities the club now have to offer. There's many players I'm looking forward to working with and learning from."
Le Saux is expected to make his debut on Saturday in Chelsea's premier league clash at Coventry.
